IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Friday, July 24, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN**
This is the money board right now. Top scale $58.70 with heavy overscale premium work — Meade Electric and Fluor paying 10% above on Meta and Eli Lilly data center builds in Lebanon. Ermco's Google Moorsville gig runs 5-10s plus Saturday. Book's deep at 174 hands for 41 calls but these are 6-month+ commitments on mission-critical infrastructure. The Meta Lebanon call alone (5-12s Mon-Fri, 10 on Sat) is the kind of iron that clears book fast.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI**
Four contractors dividing Port Washington Data Center work — Gurtz, MJ Electric, Cupertino, and Staff — all posting **JW wage + $10/hr premium** on 50–60 hour weeks. That's serious double-time energy. Repost status tells you turnover is real, but the money's concrete and the work's steady. With 188 hands chasing 47 calls, book depth is tight; you move quick here or you wait.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY**
Lake Mariner Data dominates with 117 JW slots split three ways (Ferguson, O'Connell, BESCO). Scale's $48.20, per diem available, and Ferguson alone has 61 hands needed on 7-10s. Orientation flexibility (Mon/Tue/Thu spread) makes entry smooth. Book's only 129 deep for 9 calls — nearly clear.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA**
Forty calls, 272 hands needed. Inglett & Stubbs holding the line on hospital and QTS data work at $40/hr, 4-10s with Saturday options. Miller's cable splicer role requires three years documented but pays $40.90. Whitehead's hanging cable at QTS DC3 for $40, 4-10s plus Saturday.

**LU-291 Boise, ID**
Micron PLA Idaho saturating all four contractors (Prime, EC Electric, Lea, Quality) at $45.33 with **$170/day per diem** and **$20/hr incentive wages**. PLA/LARP rates mean scale floor is negotiated. Ninety-three hands deep but 22 calls keeps it tight.

**Data centers are pulling the needle** — Azure, AWS, and manufacturing expansion pushing skilled hands onto long-term commitments at premium rates across Midwest and Mountain West.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Friday, July 24, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is running hot with 46 calls and ~140 hands needed. New River Electric Corp is moving 40 Journeyman Lineman on distribution work in Columbus at 10-hour days with a $125/night PD and $125 bonus per 10hr shift—CDL required, solid 6-10 schedule. Same contractor's got 9 more hands headed to Southern Ohio distro on 4-10s with optional weekend work. Capital Electric Line Builders is calling for 6 JW with cable splicing chops on a Johnstown project. This is volume work and they're hungry.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** sits at 20 calls, ~66 hands, but the money is cleaner. Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge Data Center job in Harwood is paying **$44.80/hr** base with **$100/day non-taxed PD Mon-Fri and $150 Sat/Sun incentive**—that's real money on a 6-10 grind within a 100+ mile GPS radius. Hunt Electric's pulling 10 hands for Grand Forks Air Base at the same scale plus an extra $100/day if you grab an ND license. Book depth is manageable here.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** is tight—9 calls, 92 hands—but Summit Line is running 40 Inside JW at **$55/hr with all OT double time**. Rosendin's at $40 base plus $15 incentive for hitting 60hrs/week average. Both NM State JIW License EE98J required; fire alarm and VESDA experience moves you up the call sheet.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** has 24 calls chasing 97 hands on the Micron PLA Idaho build. Inside JW work at **$45.33/hr** with **$170/day PD x 7 days** if eligible plus **$20/hr shift incentive**—Prime Controls, EC Electric, and Lea Electric all stacked on 60/60/50 schedules. Orientation starts July 27–this project is still ramping.

**LU-342 Greensboro, NC** is almost cleared—only 2 calls for 55 hands. CONTI Electric's Toyota Battery Manufacturing project is absorbing 33 Inside JW on 6-10s with possible Sundays and **$10 oversale premium**.

Data center and transmission megaprojects are swallowing most available hands right now; if you've got clearance, a ND license, or fire alarm credentials, you're golden.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Friday, July 24, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is running hot with 20 calls and 74 hands needed—your best chance to land steady work out West right now. BCS Mechanical's Sego Project in West Valley is stacking 28 calls for journeyman plumbers on 4-10s with OT kicker, plus 6 apprentice slots if you're coming up. DSI's QTS Eagle Mountain data center play is offering **$150/day per diem** if you're living 75+ miles out, with pipefitters working 5-8s. Pipefab's North Salt Lake shop wants chrome-experienced fitters on day shift. This is your clearest path to consistent hours in the Beehive State.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** has 20 calls against 47 hands—tighter ratio but solid industrial plays. US Eng. Metalworks is hiring 13 fitters for shop work with **15% shift differential**, and Murphy's Corden Pharma Boulder gig layers in both differential and **15% incentive pay** on top of scale, plus **$125 per diem** if you're commuting over 100 miles. Parker Advent Hospital work (Olson Plumbing) is also live. Denver's premium pay structure makes it worth the relocation math.

**LU-213 St John, NB** is refinery-heavy with Irving Oil Refinery generating 25+ calls across Lorneville, Stuart Olson, and CAM—day and night shifts available. Journeyman pipefitters on GPMA short-term agreements. This is shutdown-season volume in the Maritimes.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** has 11 calls with Nutrien shutdown work—pipefitters must be DISA current and clean-shaven, with **$150/day per diem** if you're over 50 miles. Gem's fab shop is also moving combo welders.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** is running 3 calls but MAP's Holly Frontier Sinclair refinery shutdown is DISA-required and needs 6 bodies (welders and fitters) on day shift—solid shutdown money.

The board's chasing refinery maintenance and data center buildouts; industrial shutdowns are driving regional volume spikes this quarter.
